content.title: Warranted Christian Belief
content.author: Alvin Plantinga (Oxford University Press, 2000)
content.note: The fullest statement of Reformed epistemology: belief in God can be properly basic, warranted without being inferred from arguments, through the sense of the divine. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
